dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Local-first overview of your translation workspace
dashboard.noActiveJobsBody: Start a project and its progress will appear here.
dashboard.noRecentProjectsBody: Create your first project to translate a document.
dashboard.noKeysBody: Add a key in Settings so translation can start.
dashboard.emptyTitle: Welcome — let's set up your workspace
dashboard.emptyBody: Create a project, add your AI key, then translate a PDF while keeping its layout.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Every translation project stored on this device
projects.duplicateBody: A copy with its pages and blocks is created. History is not copied.
projects.archiveBody: Archived projects are hidden from the default list and can be restored any time.
projects.unarchiveBody: The project returns to your active list.
projects.deleteBody: The project, its pages, blocks, translations and jobs are permanently removed from this device.
projects.emptyBody: Create a project to translate your first PDF document.
projects.noResultsBody: Try another search term or clear the filters.

newProject.title: New project
newProject.subtitle: Name the project and choose the language pair
newProject.sourceFileHint: PDF import arrives with Phase 2 — you can create the project now.
newProject.sameLanguage: Source and target language are the same
newProject.ocrToggle: Run OCR when a page has no text layer
newProject.ocrToggleDesc: Pages without selectable text are read with the bundled OCR engine in Phase 2.
newProject.tmToggleDesc: Matching sentences are looked up in the local translation memory first.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.placeholderBody: This workspace will parse the PDF, run OCR when needed, translate each block, let you review the result and export a rebuilt document. The pipeline state machine is already wired in.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, appearance, cache, data and providers

general.languageDesc: Applies to every menu, button and message.
general.sampleText: Translate documents while keeping their layout.

cache.title: Cache control
cache.enabledDesc: Cached translations, page renders and OCR results avoid repeat work.
cache.clearAllBody: Translations, rendered pages, OCR results and font caches are removed. Projects and edits are kept.
cache.budgetDesc: Least recently used entries are evicted automatically when a limit is exceeded.
cache.ttlDesc: Entries older than this are removed on the next read.

data.appsScriptUrlDesc: Endpoint used by Phase 5 sync. Leave empty to keep everything local.
data.appsScriptTokenDesc: Stored only on this device and never printed to logs.
data.syncEnabledDesc: Push local changes to the cloud when a connection is available.
data.autoSyncDesc: Run sync periodically while the app is open.
data.cloudNote: Cloud actions are wired in Phase 5.
data.exportDesc: Downloads every table from this device.
data.importDesc: Choose a previously exported JSON file.
data.deleteAllBody: Projects, caches, settings, keys and logs stored in this browser are erased. Export a backup first if you want to keep them.

providers.title: AI providers
providers.placeholderBody: This tab will list providers, let you add encrypted keys, pick models and test connectivity. Keys are sealed with AES-GCM before they are stored.
providers.keyStorageDesc: Keys are encrypted locally with WebCrypto AES-GCM and never sent anywhere except the provider you choose.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.enabledDesc: Shows inline suggestions while you edit translated text. Arrives with Phase 4.

about.title: About
about.storageDesc: Dexie on IndexedDB — all data stays in this browser.
about.offlineDesc: After the first visit the app shell runs from the service worker.
about.licenses: Bundled fonts: Inter, Roboto, Noto Sans, Noto Serif, Source Serif 4, Noto Sans Myanmar, Padauk (SIL Open Font License).

logs.title: Logs
logs.subtitle: Every state change and reason code emitted by the app
logs.clearBody: The event timeline stored on this device is removed.
logs.emptyBody: State changes, warnings and errors will appear here as you use the app.
logs.noResultsBody: Adjust the severity filter or search term.

myanmarTest.title: Myanmar rendering test
myanmarTest.subtitle: Stacked consonants, medials and ligatures rendered with bundled fonts
myanmarTest.stackedDesc: Vertical stacking must not clip or overlap the line above.
myanmarTest.medialsDesc: Medial strokes keep their order and shaping across line breaks.
myanmarTest.ligaturesDesc: Common conjuncts and killer signs form correct ligatures.
myanmarTest.fontsDesc: Each family below is bundled locally and available offline.
myanmarTest.lineHeightDesc: Myanmar body text uses line-height 1.75 or higher.
myanmarTest.sampleParagraph: မြန်မာစာကို ဖတ်ရှုရာတွင် စာလုံးများ တစ်ကြောင်းနှင့်တစ်ကြောင်း ကြားခြားချက် မှန်ကန်စွာ ပေါ်ထွက်ရန် လိုအပ်ပါသည်။
myanmarTest.sampleStacked: ဏ္ဍ ဋ္ဌ ဒ္ဓ ယ္ရ လ္ဝ သ္စ င်္ဂ
myanmarTest.sampleMedials: ကျ ကြ ကွ ကှ ချြ ဂွှ ငြ တ်ျွ
myanmarTest.sampleLigatures: ဿ ။ ၊ ပြ စ္စ မန္တ အောင်

pipeline.idleHint: Select a project, then start with the pre-flight check.
pipeline.noFileHint: No PDF is attached yet — parsing arrives with Phase 2.

state.offlineBody: Editing stays available; network actions resume when you reconnect.
